text:
olivia: quick heads-up: finalizing the new billing change for next quarter. switching free token credits into a time-limited CU credit bundle and tightening per-second throttles. details below.

samir: can we make the language customer-friendly? 'CU' is new jargon for many.

olivia: agreed. customer-facing will say 'compute credits (CU)' with a short tooltip. internal docs will keep the CU acronym.

billing-bot: :money_with_wings: Summary: free/trial plan -> one-off 3,000 CU promotional credit (expires 60 days after grant). Existing free credits convert at 1:1 token->CU for 2 months during migration. No surprise charges during conversion window.

claire: Invoice change: we'll add a distinct line "Compute Credits/Usage" and a small footnote with the conversion table for the first invoice cycle. @samir can you confirm the formatting for the sample PDF?

samir: will do. sending sample to #customer-success for review by EOD tomorrow.

legal: Need to add a clause in the TOS about expiration of promotional credits and VAT handling for CU refunds. We should avoid 'retroactive' in messaging.

olivia: noted. legal + finance to sync.

support-team: How should CS handle customers asking for extra time on expiring credits? are manual extensions allowed?

billing-bot: Policy: manual extensions considered for enterprise accounts only; standard accounts get the 60-day window only. Exceptions require sales sign-off.

claire: throttling note: default burst cap will change. new defaults: trial = 8 CU/s (short bursts), starter = 150 CU/s, growth = 1200 CU/s. We'll publish per-plan tables in Console and in the API docs. Throttled responses will include `X-Redwood-CU-Remaining` header plus 429.

samir: Is there a metric we can surface to customers so they see CU burn before throttle? maybe a dashboard widget.

olivia: yes, Console will get a 'CU burn rate' chart and an email alert at 70/90/99% of monthly CU commit.

billing-bot: Rollout timeline: internal beta next week, invite-only customer beta in 21 days, full opt-in open in 60 days, default for new accounts in 90 days. Conversion credit applied automatically during first billing cycle after opt-in.

olivia: action items: @samir - invoice PDF + Console banner copy; @claire - docs + Dashboard widget; @legal - TOS blurb and FAQ text; @support-team - CS script for common asks. escalate issues to #exec-ops by Thursday COB.

samir: thanks — will ping samples shortly.

olivia: thanks all. small ask: avoid using 'token tax' in public comms. :sweat_smile:
